lines.en: My joints click with every step.
In the grass, my steps are light.
I drag my steps across the floor.
My hat's askew; I straighten it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢穿过走廊，东张西望。
lines.en: I drift down the hall, glancing about.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很重，可是很慢。
lines.en: My steps are heavy, but slow.
I walk past the empty chairs.

lines.zh: 我朝着有声音的方向挪。
lines.en: I shift toward the sound.
The moon stretches my shadow long.

lines.zh: 我一停下来，一切就静了。
lines.en: When I stop, everything goes quiet.
A microphone in my left hand.
One step, another, never stopping.
I stand, eyes still glowing.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，听展厅的声音。
lines.en: I tilt my head and listen to the hall.
This suit of mine is worn.
Is someone watching the cameras?
Dew settles on my brown suit.
My music box has stopped.
The light is on me; I don't blink.
I count the cracks on the wall.
It isn't the right time yet.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过头，看另一侧。
lines.en: I slowly turn my head to the other side.

lines.zh: 你还在啊，我以为你走了。
lines.en: You're still here; I thought you'd gone.
I lower my head toward your face.

lines.zh: 你的手指在抖，我看得清。
lines.en: Your fingers tremble; I see it clearly.
Such a big showroom, and only you.
I smile; the suit doesn't move.
Don't leave; stay with me a while.

lines.zh: 我记得你，你上次也来过。
lines.en: I remember you; you came before.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，慢慢地挥了挥。
lines.en: I raise a hand and wave slowly.
Where you stand is a good spot.

lines.zh: 我在你身后站了多久了？
lines.en: How long have I stood behind you?
A tear has opened in my suit.
You think you can hit me?
What's inside has shown through.
My top hat tilts; I straighten it.
This body is harder than you.
I slowly turned my head toward you.
My joints are rattling badly.
You hit the frame inside.
I don't feel pain; I only remember.
Again; I can still stand.

lines.zh: 招牌上的东西，我不能吃。
lines.en: The things on the sign aren't for me.
Holding it up — trying to lure me?
There's no stomach in me.
I reach out only to come closer.
I know that pizzeria grease smell.
Steady your hand; I can't hold it.
I take it, then set it down.

lines.zh: 这东西没有用，但我想拿。
lines.en: This is useless, but I want it.
I'll follow you a while.
Whatever you give, I'll take.
This suit isn't soft; don't bump it.

lines.zh: 平原上的玩偶，草比我高。
lines.en: On the plains, the grass is taller than me.
You touched my arm; it's cold.
I shift aside half a step.
My joints rattled from the hit.
Don't press on me; the fabric may split.

lines.zh: 我一偏身，你就挤过去了。
lines.en: I turn and you squeeze past.

lines.zh: 这身皮囊，不是给人推的。
lines.en: This body isn't made to be shoved.
The door is too narrow for both.

lines.zh: 你退开一点，我才能转身。
lines.en: Step back so I can turn.
Another one stands on the stage.
Our suits are the same color.

lines.zh: 我们一起在空场里站着。
lines.en: We stand together in the empty hall.
Her eyes are lit too.
The music starts and we turn slowly.

lines.zh: 没有人看，我们也不在乎。
lines.en: No one watches; we don't mind.
We sit side by side at the stage edge.
In this moment, even machines seem alive.
The night has no need for pairs.
Tomorrow morning we'll still be here.
This glove, I'll keep for now.
Who dropped this here?

lines.zh: 我用僵硬的手指捏起它。
lines.en: I pinch it up with stiff fingers.
I set it back where it belongs.
This thing is heavy.
I put it in the box.
Nothing should be loose on the floor.
I hold it a while, then put it down.

lines.zh: 我记得这个，很久以前见过。
lines.en: I remember this; I saw it long ago.
Picking things up is an old habit.
You hit my suit.
I turn my head square to you.
Now it's my turn to move.
I slowly raise both hands.

lines.zh: 你惹我的那一下，我记住了。
lines.en: I remember the blow you gave me.
No one is coming to help you.
My bow tie sways in the night wind.
My steps have suddenly quickened.

lines.zh: 没褪色的玩偶，堵住墙角。
lines.en: An unfaded doll, pinning you in the corner.
I have closed this door.
The grass is too short to hide you.
Let's begin, guest.

lines.zh: 我看见你的手在找出口。
lines.en: I see your hands hunting for an exit.
Don't shout; no one hears here.
My eyes never blink.
You struck, so it gets returned.
There's no other light on the plains.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪，我就在哪出现。
lines.en: Wherever you run, I appear.
The corridor ends in a wall.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声一直没有停。
lines.en: My footsteps never stop.
You look back, and I'm looking too.
I know these plains by heart.
My shoes press into the prairie dirt.
My footsteps are lighter than yours.
Behind the door, I got there first.

lines.zh: 我一直站在你的视线外。
lines.en: I've stayed just outside your sight.
Count your heartbeats.

lines.zh: 这里的每一面墙我都摸过。
lines.en: I've touched every wall here.
Your torch is running low.
I raise my hands; enough preparing.
Only a few steps remain between us.
The eyes under my hat brim don't blink.

lines.zh: 我听见你背后的门响了。
lines.en: I heard the door behind you.
There is no one else here.
I've stood on this plain too long.
Leave the last step to me.
One slam, and it's flat.
My hand closes on your shoulder.
There's iron inside this suit.
I can't rein in the force in my palm.
This blow of mine carries force.

lines.zh: 我的另一只手也抬起来了。
lines.en: My other hand is raised too.
My blow lands among the grass roots.
I drag my steps closer.
You're down, still moving.
I look down at you.
This one is for the suit.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手臂，向后拉。
lines.en: I seize your arm and pull back.
The showroom lights flicker once.
My hat falls to the floor.
Did you hear the joints?
I lean down slowly.
You won't die fast; you'll hurt first.
My hand keeps pressing down.
Good, quiet now.
I straighten up and adjust myself.
I step out from the end of the corridor.
The lamp looks at me; I stand still.
Night-shift guest, welcome.

lines.zh: 平原上的夜，我的眼先亮。
lines.en: On the plains at night, my eyes light first.
I come down from the stage.
This place is mine to keep tonight.
The music stops, and I move.
I wear this old suit.
My shadow appears on the floor.
On the plains, my top hat appears first.
I straighten my hat slowly.
Let's play a game.

lines.zh: 我的皮套烧了起来，里面冒着烟。
lines.en: My suit catches fire and smoke rises from inside.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上翻下去，摔得散架。
lines.en: I tumble down the stairs and come apart.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的电路里，声音都乱了。
lines.en: Water floods my circuits and my sounds scramble.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，零件掉了一地。
lines.en: The blast throws me down, parts scattering.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我的皮套上。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my suit.

lines.zh: 这股光让我的关节不动了。
lines.en: This light freezes my joints.
My power is nearly drained.

lines.zh: 雷一过，我浑身抖了一会儿。
lines.en: The lightning passes and I shudder a while.

lines.zh: 这里没有地板，我踩不到。
lines.en: There's no floor here for my feet.
